name: code-walkthrough
description: Explain code out loud, line by line, with the line highlighted as it is spoken. Local Kokoro voice or browser voice.

codeWalkthrough.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, or api.openai.com/v1.

codeWalkthrough.apiKey.description: Key for the endpoint, if it needs one.

codeWalkthrough.ttsUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible speech endpoint (Kokoro-FastAPI, Speaches). Leave blank to use the browser voice.

codeWalkthrough.voiceBackend.description: openai = any /v1/audio/speech server (Kokoro-FastAPI, Speaches, LocalAI, OpenAI, VoiceStudio). kokoro = fully offline via the bundled Python runner. none = silent, paced highlight.

codeWalkthrough.ttsModel.description: TTS model id for the openai backend.

codeWalkthrough.voice.description: Voice id (Kokoro: af_heart, af_bella, bf_emma, am_michael; VoiceStudio: a voice-profile id or preset).

codeWalkthrough.pythonPath.description: Python used for the offline kokoro backend.

codeWalkthrough.localVoiceScript.description: Path to media/tts_server.py (bundled with the extension).

codeWalkthrough.ambience.description: Play a soft loop while the walkthrough runs (webview player).

codeWalkthrough.modelProvider.description: auto: use VS Code's Language Model API (your Copilot subscription, no key) and fall back to the endpoint. vscode: Copilot only. endpoint: your own OpenAI-compatible URL.

codeWalkthrough.wordLevel.description: Highlight each word inside the line as it is spoken. Needs `pip install faster-whisper`; adds ~0.05x real-time CPU per beat. Measured RTF 0.05 (14.8 s aligned in 0.8 s).
